core_meaning.primary_meaning: Awwal is an Arabic-origin name meaning “First, foremost”.

core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Awwal corresponds to the Arabic form أوّل (أ و ل). Its core sense is first, foremost. Awwal ('first, foremost'); al-Awwal is one of the divine names in Qur'an 57:3.
